profile.headline: AI Platform Engineer @ Brain Co.
profile.summary:
I’m a backend engineer focused on building reliable systems that products and teams depend on.

I’ve worked across security infrastructure, platform architecture, and backend systems powering user-facing products. I’m drawn to problems where correctness, scalability, and business needs intersect.

I care about clear system design, strong technical fundamentals, and making thoughtful tradeoffs that hold up over time.

positions.title: Software Engineering Intern
positions.description:
TestMax Inc. is leader in comprehensive test prep on mobile platforms. They offer various comprehensive courses for the LSAT and Bar Exam. 

I worked with TestMax team to create complete web-stack to extend their services over web platform. Following are few highlights of my work:
 - Designed and developed UI and logic for bubble answer sheet 
 - Created complete authentication module [+ OAuth]
 - Created user interface, models (& db migrations), business logic, and test cases for following modules:
     * Initial app walk through
     * user profile management
     * side panel menu
     * Lectures engine
     * Flashcards engine

Core Technologies: Ruby on Rails, JQuery, CSS, Bootstrap, MySQL
Shell Script -> DB backup script

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
I worked as full stack developer in creating web-based supply chain management and tracking system. Following are few highlights of my work:
•   Created rich and robust data analytic dashboard (various graphs and heatmaps).  
•   Enhanced and Optimized data import by 40%.
•   Created one-click backup and restore functionality
•   Created platform-wide tag based searching feature
•   Created shell scripts to automate deployment process.
Core Technologies: Spring, Java, ExtJS, PostgreSQL, Apache Solr

projects.title: Ninja Squirrels
projects.description:
- Implemented DFS, Greedy Best-First search, Minimax and alpha-beta pruning for simple adversarial board game. Where every player (squirrel) battles for territories with the highest yield of pine nuts.
- Programmed Using Python

projects.title: Prévoir
projects.description:
Weather forecast android application with elegant design. Application features:
- Summarized forecast for next 24 hours
- Forecast for next 7 days
- Uses AERIS weather APIs to overlay weather information (layers) on map created using OpenMaps. 
- Share weather information on facebook 


Core Technology: Android API and Java 
Core Technology Web: PHP, JQuery, JavaScript, Bootstrap, CSS3 and HTML5  [for website]
Deployed on Amazon Web Services (AWS)
